moves.canon_note: Genjitsu entered backwards — she guards the threshold, never crosses it.

made_spec.phase_enter: From neutral, step back into a guarding stance over the documented 18f entry. Weight stays back, both hands raised in guard, body angled as if holding a doorway line.
made_spec.phase_exit: Exits into GEN follow-ups (see megami-jun-core-made.json GEN entries) or back to neutral. Exit timing is NEEDS-SPEC.
made_spec.phase_hold_loop: Indefinite hold loop: small weight shifts, hands held in guard, feet planted on the threshold line. She does not advance while in this stance.
made_spec.vfx_note: No projectile or energy effect is specified in the canon note; do not add one.

moves.canon_note: The guardian's unblockable gate-slam. Slow, telegraphed, devastating.

made_spec.phase_strike: Strike frame 34: both arms slam down/forward together in a single gate-slam impact. Unblockable — the opponent must evade or interrupt during windup, not block.
made_spec.phase_windup: Frames 0-33 (documented 34f startup): slow, telegraphed raise — both arms (LP1+RP2 input) lift together as if hauling a gate shut, torso squares to the opponent. The telegraph is the point; do not speed it up.

moves.canon_note: From Threshold Keeper — the door decides. Wall splat.

made_spec.phase_entry: Must be entered from Threshold Keeper (GEN state), not from neutral.

made_spec.phase_windup: Frames 0-25 (documented 26f startup): gather from the GEN guard into a double-palm chamber (LP1+RP2 input).

made_spec.hit_count_note: NEEDS-SPEC: canon note gives no hit count or hit sequence. This spec claims ONE heavy strike phase only; do not invent a multi-hit sequence.
made_spec.phase_opening: Rage Art opening (frames 0-19, documented 20f startup): the sealed-door motif — arms draw back/open as if a door swings open, opponent is drawn into the sequence. Only usable with full Rage (RAGE input).
